|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Dewback (V)]]; it is the current text. No published image shows this card (ARMOR 4), so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB1-80E-Dewback-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 9 November 2026). The Master List slip also prints ARMOR 4; the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB1-D-dewback-pre.gif]]) and the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB1-80E-Dewback.png]]) print MANEUVER 4 (see [[Dewback (V)]]).
* '''Original''' ([[Dewback (V)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 1 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009), slip 80E, with MANEUVER 4: “Deploys only on Tatooine. Ability = ¼. May add 1 'rider' (passenger). May be targeted by Trample instead of a piloted AT-AT. During battle, may 'roar' to make a character here defense value -1.”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf Virtual Block 1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020181626/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) shows the same text.<ref name="cl-1210_80-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock1Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064706/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>
